Sources

Closed form reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation (math_art/surfaces/algebraic.py) over 240 sample points: matches oracle x 1 over 240 points (worst 3.55e-15).

  • O. Labs, 'A Septic with 99 real Nodes', Rend. Sem. Mat. Univ. Padova 116 (2006).
